articleTitle: A Two-Element Microstrip Antenna 28/38 GHz for 5G Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: A two-element antenna system is introduced with good isolation in this manuscript. The offered °G antenna gets two resonance frequencies at 28/38 GHz. The offered antenna is designed and simulated using industry-standard software CST MWS program. The elementary antenna is conventional microstrip antennas placed at the end of the mobile handset. The obtained reflection coefficient is -27.908 dB from (26.961 - 29.266) GHz with impedance bandwidth of 8.19 % and -20.58 dB from (36.646 - 40.297) GHz with impedance bandwidth of 6.09%. The two ports are coupled with less than -30 dB. The achieved directivity, far-field gain, and efficiency are 7.581 dB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>, 7.182 dB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> and 91.24 % at 28 GHz and 9.716 dB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>, 9.24 dB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> and 89.63 % at 38 GHz, respectively. The size of the Rogers 5880 substrate is 55 × 115 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with h = 0.508 mm and E r =2.2 which is a low-cost substrate and small size patches best suited for miniaturized devices.

articleTitle: Piezoelectric Thin Film Materials for Acoustic MEMS Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Piezoelectric thin film (PTF) materials present a number of unique properties in different applications, such as high sensitivity for micro electro mechanical systems (MEMS) microphones, and a wide dynamic range, wide displacement and low power consumption for MEMS speakers. Generation and detection of acoustic vibration can be made by piezoelectric devices which use the effects of direct piezoelectricity and inverse piezoelectricity. This paper covers popular PTFs and their applications for acoustic MEMS: lead zirconate titanate (PZT) based thin films and lead free PTFs such as aluminum nitride (AIN), zinc oxide (ZnO) and scandium doped aluminum nitride (ScAIN). The design, vibration mode, and fabrication will determine the frequency range of the acoustic MEMS devices. The performance and properties of PTF are the main parameter for certain MEMS applications are introduced. The main ideas of piezoelectric materials are reviewed and introduced for acoustic MEMS transducers.

articleTitle: Highly Isolated Two Elements MIMO Antenna with Band-Notched Characteristics for UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: This paper presents high performance two elements MIMO antenna to be operated for ultra-wide band applications. The MIMO antenna structure comprises of two shaped identical rad iators placed beside each other on the same substrate. The antenna composed of monopole antenna with tapered transition between the feeder and the radiating patch to obtain ultra-wide band feature from 2.6 GHz upto 12.5 GHz. Moreover, the proposed antenna produces band-notched behaviour from 5 GHz to 6 GHz by embedded open loop slot in the radiator to minimize interference with the other WLAN systems. lowering the mutual coupling between the MIMO components is accomplished by adding simple rectangular stub between the two radiators. The structure suggested is designed and measured. The MIMO UWB antenna has reflection coefficient below −10 dB within the UWB range. The transmission and correlation coefficients have values lower than −20 dB and 0.001, respectively. As well as the MIMO antenna has good omnidirectional radiation pattern with good matching between practical and simulation results.

articleTitle: A Study of Robot Control Programing for an Industrial Robotic Arm
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: The manufacturing and production industry today is still looking for improvement of their process. Programming of articulated industrial robots is a main field for manufacturing industry improvement. This work presents a study on the operation and movement control of a 6 degrees of freedom (DOF) robotic arm. A robot movement control and programming support system is presented for industrial use. Movement control programming of the robot unit is accomplished using MELFA-BASIC V which is the actual programming language for all modern Mitsubishi industrial Robots and as an industrial robot language it is very difficult to deal with. This article describes a design of programming algorithm for a movement control taking on consideration the speed and maximum possible accuracy. The presented experiment designs and analyzes speed optimizing motions on high accuracy motions. Circular motions and motions on straight line are required in the industry. In these types of motion the accuracy of the trajectory is very important.

articleTitle: High Performance Single-Phase PLL with Sliding Fourier Transform as a Phase Detector
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: A high performance single-phase phase-locked loop using sliding Fourier transform is proposed in this paper. The new PLL is using the sliding Fourier transform as a phase detector. The orthogonal signal is generated using a controlled transfer delay which is adjusted by the PLL estimated frequency. Feedback loops of the frequency and phase estimated by the PLL are used to drive the filters of the Fourier transform and to adjust the period of the transfer delay for implementing the sliding integrals. Unlike the synchronous reference frame PLL, the proposed SFT-based PLL (SFT-PLL) is adaptive to frequency changes and provides better harmonics and DC offset rejection while maintaining a constant sampling frequency. Therefore, the proposed method lends itself to digital implementation in a simple and straightforward manner. These distinguishing features allow the SFT-PLL to be especially appropriate for interfacing weak single phase micro-grids where high harmonic distortion and frequency variations are common characteristics. Experimental results and comparisons with the second order generalized integrator phase-locked loop (SOGI-PLL) are given to validate the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: Second order generalized integrator (SOGI) single-phase phase-locked loop

articleTitle: Fabrication of Flexible, Half printed and All-Solid-State Symmetric Supercapacitor Based on Silver Decorated Reduced Graphene Oxide
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Flexible supercapacitor (SC) that possess high pulse power and energy density with long lifetime is an essential need for future applications. Moreover, gel polymer liquid-based SC presents many superior advantages over aqueous organic/inorganic electrolytes such as safety, long operation temperature range, solid-state appearance and relatively high voltage window. Therefore, Silver decorated reduced graphene oxide (RGO) coupled with developed (H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>/PVA/GO/ polyaniline) gel polymer were used to fabricate the SCs, which offers flexibility, durability, safety and ability to apply high scan rates. Influence of different ratios of silver to GO weight on specific capacitance and performance were studied. The SCs were prepared by printing technique (layer by layer) then peeled of the basic plastic substrate. After that, silver thin films were sputtered on both sides of the printed SCs as the current collectors using a shadow mask. Interestingly, a specific capacitance of about 164 F/g correlated with 29.5 Wh/Kg energy were achieved correlated with using H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> that is considered to be a weak electrolyte. Moreover, 0.5 ohm represents the smallest electric series resistance that would directly affect the power of the fabricated solid-state SC. The composite was studied using Raman spectroscopy, TEM and XRD, whereas, The VSP-300 potentiostat/galvanostat was used for extensive electrochemical characterizations of the prepared asymmetric SCs.

articleTitle: Automatic Parking Control using Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: The aim of the paper is to propose a methodology control of parking process using fuzzy logic. The simplified vehicle, in which the design will be realized, is made in MSC Adams environment. This created vehicle model is afterwards exported to Matlab Simulink. In this environment is realized the design of the vehicle motion control through co-simulation using fuzzy controller. The design is tested and implemented for the control of the parking process in different parking situations, specifically for perpendicular and parallel parking.

articleTitle: Triple-band Notched Ultra-Wideband Antenna With Bluetooth Support
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: In this paper, a new design of triple band notched at Wi-MAX frequency band, WLAN band and X-band for FCC ultra wide band planar antenna is proposed. The design composed of a rectangular monopole antenna with three defected slits at the top and merged with three steps with different widths to connect with the main feeding line. An open trapezoidal slot is etched at the top of the ground plane. Two etched slots on the patch antenna look like U-shaped used to reject the WLAN operating band. Two folded C-shaped band stop filter placed on both sides of the feeding line in order to prevent the Wi-MAX spectrum frequency. Two electromagnetic band gap structures are located on the both sides of the feeding line to prevent the X-band frequency. Besides that, the proposed design operates at the Bluetooth frequency. The UWB design occupies the spectrum band from 2.06 GHz to 16 GHz except at the three notch bands.

articleTitle: Operation Study of a Combined System of Diesel Engine Generators and Wind Turbine with Battery Storage System
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: In this research work, the operation plan of diesel engine generator (DEG) and wind turbine (WT) with battery storage system (BSS) is optimized as a nonlinear system considering load profile. Furthermore, three types operation cases. Case 1: load profile is feed by DEG, Case 2: load profile is feed by WT with BSS, and Case 3: load profile is feed by combined system of DEG, and WT with BSS. These sources are suggested to deliver energy to a micro grid of nine household in RED SEA governorate, Egypt. A comparison study between the three operating cases is satisfied. This research work reports that the total performance of the combined system of case 3 is higher than independent operation of each system according to the system cost and emission of gases.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Supercapacitor Based on Reduced Graphene Oxide for Energy Storage Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: The demand for high-performance supercapacitors (SCs) and non-conventional energy harvesting systems that possess the requirements of high power density and long lifetime is an essential need for future applications. Despite the usage of carbon material in commercial SCs, reduced graphene oxide (RGO) attracted great concerns due to its unique properties such as superior chemical and thermal stability, high surface area, 2D structure, and high electrochemical performance. In this work, reduced graphene oxide (RGO) was synthesized chemically by the reduction of graphene oxide prepared by improved Hummer method then modified by thermal reduction. After that, a symmetric supercapacitor electrodes were prepared by the coating of RGO paste on graphite substrates to reduce contact resistance and promote electrochemical stability. The CR2032 coin-cell was used as the standard cell package and KOH (6M) as a strong alkaline electrolyte. The electrochemical behavior of the cell was investigated by using Bio-Logic VSP-300 where high specific capacitance of 158 F/g was achieved at 5 mv/s scan rate. Interestingly, retention obtained was about 95% after 1000 cycles coupled with power and energy densities and 2000W/Kg and 14.4Wh/Kg at 1A, respectively. On the other hand, the microstructure and surface morphology of RGO was investigated using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-Ray diffraction.

articleTitle: DC and AC Power Distribution Systems in Photovoltaic Generation for Household Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: During the last decade, DC power distribution represents a remarkable increase with renewable energy (RE) generation especially with photovoltaic (PV) systems. DC power distribution with PV system creates a wide prospect for using DC power for residential applications. One of the most challenges to enlarge PV generation is to reduce its cost. Inverter (DC - AC) and its annual maintenance cost represent a considerable value in a PV system, which can be eliminated in case of DC power distribution. This paper is comparing the cost of energy (KWH) in case of AC and DC power distribution for a defined PV system. The studied system can be considered as a model for PV residential application powered by a PV system in developing countries. The two AC and DC systems are simulated and costs of energy are compared to determine the generated energy cost using Homer software.

articleTitle: Supercapacitor Assisted Low Dropout (SCALDO) Regulators for Power Systems Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Despite the advantages and importance of conventional linear regulators, low efficiency of about 40% is one of the main corresponding drawbacks. Supercapacitor assisted low dropout regulator (SCALDO), a linear DC to DC technique that can be used to duplicate efficiency. Therefore, supercapacitor is playing a crucial role to maximize the efficiency as a result of nearly lossless voltage dropper element, which minimize the losses in the pass element and power semiconductors. This work represents the mathematical principles of SCALDO and a simple implementation with simple and costly effective electronic components contrary to the traditional techniques. The proposed low dropout regulator is used to convert 12V to 5V. The linear regulator based on high efficiency SCALDO technique makes it appropriate for solar cell power systems applications.

articleTitle: Damping of Tower Crane Payload Vibrations
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: The paper deals with compensator design for damping payload vibrations of a laboratory tower crane (TCR). TCR is used as a research and education aid to demonstrate control problems of mechatronics. The focus is on dynamic model identification and design of a compensator to damp payload vibration in the x-direction.

articleTitle: FPGA-based Implementation of a Tree-based Classifier using HW-SW Co-design
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: FPGA-based implementation of tree-based classifiers has been a very promising approach due to the ability of FPGA to execute tasks in parallel, which speeds up the processing tasks and saves power. The challenge with FPGA implementation is the need to build all classifier components in hardware, structure format, which is time-consuming and does not follow the best practices in creating modular design architecture. This paper addresses this issue by proposing a hardware-software codesign implementation of a tree-based classifier that uses ID3 algorithm for classification tasks. We used the Xilinx microblaze processor inside the FPGA to execute ID3 algorithm functions, while using hardware modules for pre-processing and feature engineering tasks.

articleTitle: A Survey of Some Interdisciplinary Methods and Tools to Measure Learners' Emotions in Intelligent Tutoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Emotion measurement in Educational technology is an important topic which amalgamates the computer-based education (specifically the intelligent tutoring systems ITS) and the emotion measurement. This will have a positive effect for gradually improving the performance of the educational process. It will be fruitful for the educational environment to adopt the measuring emotions techniques, emotion intelligence, and emotion recognition. This is useful for collecting information about students' emotions and directs the educational process to better performance. Adopting such technologies will face some challenges. Some of these challenges include data acquisition from the physiological and psychological tools, handling of different data types, manipulation of data, decision to recover the detected problem, cost of both the physiological and psychological tools,....etc. The researchers are interested in this field of studies to adapt instruction to develop the responding of a student's affective state. So, these studies will take student gradually to the best performance in his educational material.

articleTitle: MIMO-Software Defined Radio based GPR System for Land Mine Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-input multi-output (MIMO) coherent transmit and receive Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) system, totally software-defined, is presented. all its Tx/Rx parameters can be controlled by the software along with signal processing capability of digitized signals. The system is capable of transmitting and receiving signals over the band of 450 MHz to 6 GHz. To cover this wide band range of frequencies, Three Log Periodic Directive Antennas (LPDA`s) ultra-wideband (UWB) antennas are designed, fabricated and tested. These antennas can be switched using microwave switches. A software-defined and computer-controlled 8-inputs and 32-outputs antenna switching matrix is realized using 1×4 microwave switches. The proposed system can be considered as a non-invasive sensor to detect and image underground targets for various applications that includes detection of land mines, tunnels, bunkers, utility pipes and exploration of natural resources like oil, gas, etc.

articleTitle: Comparison of Optimization Techniques for Process Recognition Using Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: This paper brings the topic of comparison of optimization techniques using gradient descent, gradient descent with momentum, Adam and learning rate decay in combination with previous optimization algorithms for face recognition using deep neural network. This paper compares several settings of these techniques as well as techniques among themselves with combination of regularization techniques varying in using no regularization, L2 regularization and dropout to successfully recognize the sex of a person captured. The result of the evaluation is taken in a matter of successfully recognized face rate for train data and test data, cost and deep neural network learning time.

articleTitle: Smart Phone Brake Testing
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: This document presents mobile application for periodic technical inspection of car brake systems. It mimics the commonly used decelerometer functions. It is based on smartphone inertial measurement unit to determine car deceleration. The application takes advantage of contemporary smartphone features such as connectivity and additional sensors such as satellite positioning system sensors. It is being developed by the Institute of Automotive Mechatronics of Slovak University of technology and TESTEK a.s. which is the Authorized technical Service for Technical Inspections of Vehicles in Slovak Republic.

articleTitle: Micro-Machined Heater Designed for Miniaturized Thermal IR Sources
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: In this paper, Thermal-Electrical Finite Element Method (FEM) has been utilized to model and analyze thermal distribution of a joule micro heater machined on a highly doped silicon substrate. The heater filament is made of Platinum (Pt) while the oxide layer is from Aluminum Oxide (Al2O3) for better adhesion to Pt. The thermal distribution as well as the temperature variation within the active area of different multi rings designs at different voltages are presented. Thermal-Electrical FEM simulations were conducted on three different designs single, double, and triple-rings filaments. Simulations show that triple-ring heater has the most uniform thermal radiation performance, which suggest make it a promising candidate design for miniaturized thermal IR sources.

articleTitle: Implementation of Electrical Separation of Brushless DC Motor Phases for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: This document is to present theoretical and experimental application to electrically isolate the three stages of the Brushless DC motor (BLDCM). Eight-switches bridge converter (ESBC) is used to assist electrically decouple the three-phase of BLDCM. Presentation of BLDCM's efficiency applicable to Electric Vehicle (EV). To boost system reliability, ESBC is used to drive the BLDCM. ESBC's performance features are checked under various working circumstances. MATLAB code (m-file) used to introduce the performance features of ESBC. Two theoretical systems are built for medium and low motor power ratings (m-file) code. To verify the simulation analysis, an experimental setup is introduced. The validity of the simulation is confirmed by a comparison between theoretical and experimental results.

articleTitle: Shunt PPF Shunt Fuzzy APF based on MMC Compensating Current Harmonics
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Nonlinear loads inject current harmonics which has bad influence on the electrical. In this paper, shunt passive shunt active power filter is introduced for compensating this current harmonics. For increasing the reliability of the power injector, modular multilevel converter is used. A Matlab/Simulink model is presented to justify the system performance and its capability in enhancing the total harmonic distortion.

articleTitle: Fabrication Of 2032 Coin Cell High Power Electric Double Layer Supercapacitor Using Neutral Electrolyte
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: In this paper we present a general approach for the full packaged 2032 coin cell supercapacitor (SC) based on activated carbon (AC) electrode material and Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> neutral electrolyte. Electrochemical properties of the coin cell supercapacitor were analyzed using VSP 300. Galvanostatic charge/discharge (GCD), cyclic voltammetry (CV) and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) tests were performed. The electrochemical performance of the supercapacitor showed a relatively high specific capacitance of 90.4 F/g. interestingly, high power density of 1968.56w/kg coupled with using neutral electrolyte that promotes stability, safety and life cycle. The obtained power is due to the cell configuration.

articleTitle: Adaptive PI-Based Fuzzy Logic Auto-Tuning Controller Design and Implementation for Tactile Shape Display Device
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Tactile displays have been proposed as a human-computer interface. Nowadays, it is utilised in hundreds of applications and a standard means of information presentation. Shape information display became essential to many surgical tasks (finding hidden anatomical features and locating tumours). There is a strong need for shape tactile display devices particularly for specialists who ought to feel the tissue shape and hardness amid laparoscopic surgeries. This paper describes the design and implementation of adaptive position controller for a tactile shape display device. The proposed display comprises of an cluster of 3×3 upward/downward free mobile pins based on SMA actuators. Each actuator is competent of creating a 5 mm uprooting as greatest. Due to the complex hysteresis and non-linear response of SMA actuators, a fuzzy logic auto-tuner algorithm is constructed to create the PI controller gains adaptive. The suggested controller is implemented to control the shape display tactile system. The proposed controller present prevalent response over existing controllers in the survey from point of no steady state error, no overshoot, no chattering and minimized hysteresis.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modelling and Control of quadrotor's attitude around its hover position
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: An Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) quadrotor, which has many applications concerning civilian and military purposes with a high risk mission. This paper deduces the dynamic modeling of UAV and designs a traditional PID controller that controls and stabilizes the quadrotor's attitude around its hover position. The dynamical model and controllers which proposed or compared and verified of a UAV quadrotor were simulated employing MATLAB /Simulink. The quadrotor control was verified by comparing its results with another sliding mode controller results to ensure that the traditional PID controller is efficient.

articleTitle: Implementation of Cuckoo Search Optimized PIDDTC and FLDTC of PMSM with NEDC Reference Speed
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: In this paper, the New European-Driving-Cycle (NEDC) is used as a reference speed to test the performance of an advanced permanent-magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drive at a wide range of speed changes. The new advanced artificial intelligent based direct torque control (DTC) speed drives are optimally designed and implemented in real time to achieve high performance with alternating current drive for a PMSM used in Electric Vehicles (EVs), where Cuckoo Search (CS) algorithm is used with the standard DTC (PIDDTC) and with the Fuzzy Logic DTC (FLDTC) based speed controllers. For the real-time implementation of the overall system, dSPACE DS1202 is used and the controllers' responses against the NEDC are obtained. The system is tested at no load and a comparison between the two developed advanced drives is performed.

articleTitle: A 90-nm CMOS Low-Energy Dual-Channel Serial/Parallel Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: This paper presents an integrated 90-nm CMOS low-energy dual-channel multiplier based on the serial/parallel scheme. Moreover, a comparative study of different multipliers is accomplished at 90 nm CMOS technology. Due to the tendency of the market to minimize devices' size to make them portable, small implementation area is considered by using the dual-channel multiplier. In this paper, a new implementation of multiplication process comes to exceed the battery lifetime by decreasing the power consumption by up to 93%. Furthermore, there is a reduction in the area by up to 67% as compared with previous work which makes it more appropriate for low power handheld devices applications. Also, great saving in energy is attained by using the proposed scheme when performing complex multiplications task.

articleTitle: Design and Manufacturing of Polyaniline- based Thermoelectric Generators
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Thermoelectric materials have high capability of harvesting heat energy to electricity with high efficiency. Poly aniline (PANI) as a conductive polymer is used to host multi wall carbon nano tubes (MWCNTs) with 30wt %. Two samples of pure PANI and PANI loaded with 30wt% MWCNTs were prepared and compared to evaluate their power factor and electrical conductivity. Pure PANI showed 0.038 mA at 1 V while 30wt % of MWCNTs showed 2.2 mA at 1 V, both at 50°C. A prototype based on 30wt % MWCNTs was manufactured and a maximum current and maximum volt of 29.5 mA at 80°c and 1.41 V at 100°c are reported, which is a large achievement compared to previous work.

articleTitle: High Efficiency of Linear Switched Reluctance Motor for Railway Vehicle System
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: An oversized air gap linear rotational switched reluctance motors (LSRMs) have been manufactured and developed for a test track of railway vehicles. These motors are proposed owing to their roughness, simple configuration, and their ability to operate in harsh environments. The stator is formed of a standard coupling of 3 six-pole SRM stators that are properly biased. The rotor is made of several common eight poles SRM stacks. The linear movement is already ensured by the motor. The purposes of the design and control are to exploit the effectiveness and to lessen auditory noise for the given motor parameters. For safe and effective application of electromagnetism lift as well as steering systems for motors which have an inherently unstable characteristic, an innovative system is meant to regulate both the air gap position and winding current using the PI regulator. Mechanical vibration is reduced, and driving quality is improved. The results of a large-scale dynamic modelling of an integrated system are displayed.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Hybrid Sliding Mode and Classical Controllers for Ni-Ti SMA Smart Actuator Position Control
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: In this paper, a comparative analysis of Hybrid Sliding Mode PI and classical PI with intelligent properties controllers for Ni-Ti SMA smart actuator position control is presented. The SMA actuator mechanical dynamics are obtained using one-way actuator model. The actuator returns to its initial position using bias spring force. The SMA material model using the shear-strain driven approach is discussed. Two different controllers are presented and compared as a SMA actuator position controllers. The Hybrid Sliding Mode PI and the classical PI with intelligent properties controllers are compared. The comparison results depict that the controller with intelligent properties advantages surpass the advantages of the Hybrid Sliding Mode PI controller and it improves the rising and settling times of output displacement response. Both controllers provide output displacement without overshoot and zero steady state error which are essential in smart actuators applications.

Author Keywords: Hybrid Sliding Mode PI Controller (HSM PI controller)

articleTitle: CPW DC Pass Filters for RF Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Two different coplanar waveguide DC pass filters are introduced in this paper. The proposed coplanar filters have both the filter conductive lines and the ground plane on the same side of the substrate, that gives two advantages of wider bandwidth than the microstrip structure and avoiding the via holes through the substrate when connecting the devices such as diodes, capacitors or inductors. The proposed filters are developed to be integrated with rectenna systems after the rectifier circuit. The first DC pass filter consists of one series straight short end stub, and three shunt bent short end stubs. These stubs are used to reject specific harmonics according to the stub length and position. The second DC pass filter is coplanar fan stub filter. It consists of single stub with fan shape which achives wider rejection frequency bandwidth with smaller area than the first filter. The fan shape stub DC filter shows good performance in the rejection from 1.8 GHz to 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Improved Dynamics Proportional-Integral Control of Four-Phase 8/6 Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: This paper presents an improved dynamics proportional-integral (IDPI) speed control for four-phase 8/6 switched reluctance motor (SRM). The SRM is used in the industrial applications owing to its simple structure, low cost, fault-tolerance, and high torque to inertia ratio. In this paper, the 75 kW, four-phase 8/6 SRM is supplied from asymmetric power converter (APC) with soft switching method. The parameters of the proposed IDPI speed control are calculated from the mechanical mathematical model and the pre-defined drive system response. By obtaining the IDPI parameters, different speed response can be accomplished at various operating conditions. Moreover, the SRM currents are controlled by hysteresis current control (HCC). The proposed IDPI is assessed and compared with the neural network and the conventional PI controllers. The comparison between the three controllers comprises the rise time, settling time, overshoot, undershoot, speed error, and the torque ripples percentage. The proposed IDPI robustness is investigated during load disturbance and 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> increase in the motor inertia conditions.

articleTitle: Compact Adiabatic Taper for SOI Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel design of an adiabatic compact taper which can be used as a converter between a grating coupler and a single-mode optical fiber at 1550 nm wavelength. The proposed taper in this paper is coupling the light between a wide grating coupler with width 15μ and nanophotonic waveguide with width 500nm. Besides, the length of the proposed design is 22μm. Therefore, it is a compact design as it has a small footprint which leads to high efficiency and low costs in fabrication. The coupling efficiency is around 92%.

articleTitle: Innovative Method for Enhancing High-Power LED Driver Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: This study indicates a converter based on change condenser to drive a high power light emitting diodes LEDs. Unlike standard steady current DC drivers, change condenser provides the current pulse. The recommended approach varies from the classical switch capacitor as it utilizes a little inductor to improve the swapping performance of the converter. The impact of condensers on the chosen regulator is demonstrated and examined based on the charging control analysis. A 3 W, 220 V experimental prototypes has been implemented when the outcomes are reported and explained in order to show that the proposed converter is practically feasible and can be used as LED driver.

articleTitle: H∞ robust controller design using regional pole placement constraint
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: The proposed paper addresses the problem of output / state H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> robust controller design using regional pole placement constraints. In the paper the original bounded real lemma is obtained in the convex form with respect to uncertainty and regional pole placement constraints. The examples show the effectiveness of the proposed new controller design procedure.

articleTitle: Co-Planar Waveguide Resonator to Mediate Coupling between Superconducting Quantum Bits
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: This paper proposes a design of a coplanar waveguide resonator (CPWR) to integrate two distant superconducting qubits which is a function required for a quantum information system. In this CPWR, the states of one of the super conducting qubits can be moved to and recovered from the other qubit by microwave resonator photons. The superconducting qubits are relatively straightforward to fabricate from materials such as aluminium using electron beam lithography. The superconducting qubits, which are typically a few hundred micrometres in size, are well suited to perform fast quantum logic gate operations. The CPWR highly couples the two qubits through the tightly confined oscillating magnetic field of the resonator microwave photons. It is shown that, in the proposed CPW resonator structure, the microwave photons can mediate coupling between two distant superconducting qubits (21 mm apart) to realize quantum logic gates.

articleTitle: Different Aspects That Affect Sizing of Battery Energy Storage in PV Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: The renewable energy is growing in significant way especially photovoltaic (PV) system in order to keep up with huge needs of electricity. However, the PV output power is suffering from both; intermittency and environmental condition which have great influence on its performance. So, using batteries as complementary source becomes imperative with PV system. Therefore, the batteries must be sizing precisely. In this paper, the different aspects which affect the battery sizing will be explained. These factors will figure out the system behavior and performance. The main aim of this paper is to acquire high system efficiency and reliability with optimal cost.

articleTitle: On-line Fault Detection and Diagnosis of Continuous Processes Based on Mahalanobis Distance
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: This paper presents a fault detection and diagnosis approach based on Mahalanobis distance (MD) for monitoring continuous processes. The Mahalanobis distance is first used to detect sensor faults, and its control limit is determined by the empirical method via specification a significance level. The main idea behind Mahalanobis distance is using the whole data information instead of dimensionality techniques such as partial least squares, canonical variate analysis, and principal component analysis. The data reflected by the detection index, MD, is analysed by a fault diagnosis method, i.e, contributions plots. An integrated approach for fault detection and diagnosis is presented and tested by two simulation studies, Monte Carlo simulation data and continuous stirred tank reactor chemical process(CSTR). The results illustrate the reliability of the proposed approach in detecting and diagnosing sensor faults.

articleTitle: Gain enhancement for Polarization Diversity antenna at 2.45 GHz
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: This article presents gain enhancement for polarization diversity antenna at 2.45 GHz by using a planar folded transmitarray antenna (FTAA). The design of antenna consists of three parts, small dimensions rhombus shape antenna for polarization diversity [1] (feeding element), transmitarray (TA), and PEC plate (reflector). Rhombus shape antenna produces RHCP and LHCP by using two PIN diodes. The gain is enhanced by integration the FTAA and the rhombus shape antenna in a folded techniques using PEC plate. The folded technique achieves a compact shape for the antenna. The FTAA radiation characteristics are investigated. Gain enhanced is around 13 dBi compared with 2 dBi from rhombus shape antenna. Axial ratio is about 1.5 dB.

articleTitle: Tuning Methods to Attenuate Oscillatory Load-Disturbance Response: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: The paper deals with the proportional-derivative (PD) compensator tuning to attenuate oscillatory response evoked by an impulse disturbance at the input of the controlled plant. Selected tuning methods are surveyed, applied to a benchmark example and compared in terms of time- and frequency domain performance measures.

articleTitle: E-Health applications over 5G networks: challenges and state of the art
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Nowadays, the evolution of 5G technologies has a great effect on different application varying from automotive to real-time health care applications. Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN) is considered as the prime technology utilized for health care systems. This article presents an outline of the intelligent employ of 5G technologies in a WBAN health care application. As well as it gives advantages and disadvantages of the integration of WBAN health care system along with 5G and the architecture of WBAN based on 5G technology. Additionally, the role of mm-wave in the communication among WBAN and the role of 5G in communicating WBAN to the outer world have been discussed. Finally, various 5G health care application has been illustrated.

articleTitle: Internet of Vehicles (IoV) enabled 5G D2D technology using proposed resource sharing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Internet of Vehicles (IoV) importance has been arisen to reduce the current road accidents and provide smarter, greener, and safer Intelligent Transport System (ITS). The wide deployment of 5G cellular network, supported by device-to-device (D2D) technology, can afford the infrastructure to enhance IoV.This paper investigates the resource assignment performance issues and proposes a Maximum Power Allocation algorithm (MAX-PA) for both Vehicles to Infrastructure (V2I) and Vehicles to Vehicles (V2V); where multiple V2V links can share the same channel with a V2I link. Furthermore, the proposed algorithm is provided to guarantee reliability for V2V links while maximizing the V2I links ergodic capacity. Finally, the MAX-PA algorithm performance is evaluated and the simulation results are presented and compared with other existing algorithms to show the enhancement.

articleTitle: Overview of Power System Flexibility Options with Increasing Variable Renewable Generations
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Many energy systems around the world tend to generate electricity from renewable energy sources as an alternative to the use of high-carbon fossil fuels. Increasing the rate of inclusion of renewable power plants in power systems at the expense of conventional power plants will result in new challenges in dealing with the unexpected generation capacity of these plants. This research discusses the various flexibility options for power systems in dealing with this variable and uncertain generating capacity at different time intervals to achieve the desired balance between generating capacity and load needs.

articleTitle: Localization Methods for Internet of Things: Current and Future Trends
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Internet of things (IoT) is a network which consists of billions of small sensors which communicate with each other to obtain solutions for environmental problems. The location information is very important to know where the data come from. This paper introduces and analyzes different categories of localization in IoT from different views. The advantages and disadvantages of each technique and which application it is suitable for will be demonstrated.

articleTitle: Compensation the Unbalance of Non-Linear Load Based on Three-Leg Center-Split Inverter Four Wire
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: The unbalance problem in low voltage distribution systems is considered as an important issue related to the power quality aspects. The effects on the electric power system for both the utility and the consumers are also introduced. The related economic and technical considerations have been introduced. Several compensation techniques are also listed. This paper presents the configurations used as a solution for the unbalance problems. The 3-leg with Center-Split Inverter is selected as a standard inverter with lower semiconductor switches numbers. Two control methods are applied for the selected topology; Three Dimensional Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (3D-SVPWM), Hysteresis. 3D-SVPWM with the steps of the required procedure is discussed, Hysteresis control is also applied. The power circuit with the unbalanced load with their relative block control diagram are presented. The results show that the topology of 3-Leg inverter with a split capacitor point succeed to minimize the unbalance at the PCC. Minimization of the neutral current at the source with stabilizing the DC voltage is achieved. The two control methods can restore the balancing for the unbalanced load.

articleTitle: Student Modeling Using Educational Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Educational Data Mining (EDM) is a research area which applies machine learning, data mining and statistical techniques to different types of data that come from educational settings. Student modeling is one of EDM applications that used to recommend or adapt the educational system resources. This paper explores the different educational systems and their characteristics. In addition, modeling of the student learning style, affective state, and prediction of the student performance are addressed. Profiling, grouping students and collaboration analysis are also explored.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic-Based Interconnected-Modified DC-Nanogrids within an Open Energy Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: A DC nano-grid is typically intended as a reliable scheme capable of delivering power to the local loads from distributed renewable energy resources. The conventional nano-grid uses two-separate conversion stages for feeding both ac and dc loads. But, the modified design for the dc nano-grid uses only a single-stage converter. It is based on a single-input power-electronic multi-output converter that interfaces the source with the average load requirements. It deals with a switched boost inverter (SBI) that can fed from a solar photovoltaic (PV) renewable energy source. SBI is a single-stage power converter capable of simultaneously supplying both dc and a higher or lower ac loads from a single dc input voltage source. The converter operation is also contributed by a simple model reference adaptive closed loop control technique, to fed the high output ratings steadily, especially in the critical range for its duty ratio. In addition, this paper presents a full model design for multiple interconnected nanogrids through a dc-link within a multilevel direct current (dc) scheme called an open energy distributed system (OEDS). Each nanogrid involves a switched boost inverter (SBI) providing its closed-loop control method for its dc-link voltage. Moreover, this paper involves a controller method to attain the optimum power flow with high reliability for the suggested interconnected nanogrids. The proposed systems are modelled and simulated with the help of MATLAB/Simulink software package to assess the robustness of the proposed OEDS with multiple 5-Kw interconnected nanogrids fed from photovoltaic (PV) renewable energy resources.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Open-data Data Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: The main purpose of the paper is to implement a data warehouse using opendata from various sources. We bring the overview of the data warehouse fundamentals in general and also the motivation of the open-data. The data supposed to provide various answers and offer suitable decision making for the general public. The implementation consists of various technologies. The target is to find open government data and to analyze the data to create a business model while meeting the data warehouse requirements such as ensure quality, integrity and consistency of the data transformation and integration. The key object of the data warehouse is to make it available and accessible for anyone.

articleTitle: Technical Investigation for Power System Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Power systems face growing flexibility requirements for managing the increased penetrations from variable renewable generation (VRG) like solar and wind power generation. In general, instant balance of temporal inequalities between supply and demand can be reached by many flexibility options. However, an accurate quantification of the flexibility needed and available in a power system is a complex task. Accordingly, this paper introduces a review of various power system flexibility metrics that used to quantify the flexibility. The use of these metrics varied, some of which were used to measure the flexibility available from each conventional generator and others were used to measure the flexibility available and needed by the power system at both the planning and operational stages, but up till now there is no flexibility metric that can be taken as a standard.

articleTitle: A Comparative study for Feature Extraction and Classification of Images
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Digital images increased rapidly due to the usage of users to the Internet, digital camera and their cell phones. The huge amounts of images are used for different purposes: business, education, recording/sharing events, remembering, etc. Most commercial and online shopping companies rely on images to attract consumers to visit and buy their products. Image classification is a core task for most of such applications. The performance of a classifier depends on two main factors: the features extracted from the images and the classification techniques. Many feature extraction algorithms are proposed by researchers such as Local Binary Pattern, Maximally Stable Extermal Regions, Speed Up Robust Features and Deep Convolutional Neural Networks. This paper tries to experimentally compare among these different feature extraction algorithms by applying different classifiers with each one. These classifiers are Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, k-Nearest Neighbors and Naive Bayes. The classifiers were learned from a dataset of eight categories: animals, food, nature, building, tourism, people, sport and apparatus. Our experiments show that SVM achieves 93.89% accuracy when Residual Neural Network is used as a feature detector and SVM as a classifier.

articleTitle: Different Types of Partially Reduced Graphene Oxide as Mild Heat Sensors for Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Graphene oxide suspension was spin-coated on a glass substrate and reduced at 300 °C in vacuum to produce partially reduced graphene oxide (PRGO) thin film, which was used as a temperature sensor device. The PRGO film showed high-temperature dependent resistance coefficient of Kilo ohms per degree. Nevertheless, it failed in the test of durability and stability along with many cycles. On the other hand, polymethacrylate encapsulated PRGO (PMMA-PRGO) thin film to form a compact structure. Hence, it overcomes the bare film drawbacks and featured much better durability and reversibility with rather relatively low resistance. Observed temperature limits, IV curves perturbation and irreversibility were discussed. Polymer encapsulation process proved efficacious in enhancing even PRGO non-steady structure as a p-type semiconductor. Besides, it promotes functionalization of several degrees of reduced graphene oxide GO for relevant electronic applications. On sensing terms, PMMA-PRGO not only presented hundreds of ohms for each one degree but also symmetrical liner drop over temperature that makes it a promising within mild range. This work suggests a simple technique to produce stable RGO based electronics as a semiconductor of reduction dependent bandgap.

articleTitle: Convergence of Ensemble Averaging for Optical Scattering on Rough Surfaces using GTD-RT
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: In this paper, a new robust and computationally efficient method that uses the geometrical theory of diffraction (GTD) in conjunction with the ray tracing (RT) technique is presented to assess the electromagnetic scattering pattern due to a plane wave incident on a rough surface of quite arbitrary statistical parameters. The development of the proposed technique is explained in detail taking into consideration the generation of the geometrical model of the rough surface. The Fresnel reflection model is applied under the assumption of arbitrary electrical and optical properties of the rough surface material. Also the polarization of the plane wave primarily incident on the rough surface is taken into consideration. The accuracy of the obtained results is verified through the comparison with the experimental measurements of the scattering pattern of a light beam incident on rough sheets with specific statistical properties. The numerical results of the present work are concerned with investigating the dependence of the scattering pattern on the roughness of surface, the incidence angle, and the correlation length of the rough surface. It is shown that the proposed methods for generating the rough surface model and evaluating the optical scattering require a small-size ensemble of the random rough surface model to get accurate results, which reflects the computational efficiency of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Automated Railway Security System
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Being faster, larger and more reliable, today's trains have permeated the other means of transportation as the prime mode between several countries. However, railroad-related ac-cidents are also more perilous in damage and loss of lives. Therefore, in common railway security systems, more strivings are required for strengthening the safety. Moreover, manual observing of the tracks is actually impracticable and unreliable. Thus, to avoid collisions and allow a better communication between train, central control headquarters, and passengers, this paper, being focused in establishing an automated railway security prototype model using advanced electronic circuits, a communication module, and the proposed mobile interfaces. It is established on an Arduino UNO embedded platform to introduce automatic control crossing gates, switching train tracks and detecting line cracks with the aid of electronic sensors like IR sharp sensor, ultrasonic sensor, and gyroscopes. Moreover, by employing the web camera, the operator of the control room could get real status updating and have a continuous behavior monitoring during the train journey. Thus, the railway gate could be highly controlled so the road traffic will be wholly prophesied. Especially on dangerous trips, the train is supported by the developed dummy car which can detect and monitor any causes of risks on the railway lines and send that fault to the concerned authority. To offer different services for drivers and passengers, the proposed Android applications are responsible for obtaining the sensed data through the Bluetooth module and broadcasting urgent data to the control room. As the accuracy of automated operations is usually more accurate than manual operations, fatal errors due to human mistakes could be easily limited. Thus, compared to related systems, the proposed automatic railway security system which is cost-effective will be robust enough to facilitate much safety standards to Egypt railways.

articleTitle: An Approach for Automatic Detection of Quran Quotation (DQQ) in Arabic Texts
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: Quran language includes the most eloquent Arabic styles, structures, and vocabulary that a language can express. Most brilliant and creative writers have been affected by Quranic styles, vocabularies, structures, and meanings. This paper attempts to measure this effectiveness by matching similar language units with the Quranic language units. This similarity expands all over the linguistic analysis levels (morphological, syntactical, and semantic levels). Then identifies them with their positions in the text and clarifies the similarity automatically. A suggested tool called Detection Quran Quotation (DQQ) is able to accomplish this. DQQ can also be useful in the researches which discover quoted texts, plagiarism, heritage verification, and copyright issues. It will help in many applications, such as text similarities, summarization, and text analysis on all of its levels. In this paper, we explain the architecture of our proposed Quranic quotes detection framework. The DQQ is a framework that takes an Arabic text as an input and outputs the quote ratio results. The framework architecture is the first part of a project and is still under testing.

articleTitle: Electrical performance Investigations of stand-alone CPV system in Egypt connected to a pump load
publicationTitle: 2019 6th International Conference on Advanced Control Circuits and Systems (ACCS) & 2019 5th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics & information Technology (PEIT)
abstract: The European Commission has subsidized a project for concentrated photovoltaic (CPV) from January 2009 to December 2012. The principal goal was to bring together the owners of the most advanced European CPV technology in order to research new applications for CPV systems. Its main objective was the installation of a stand- alone CPV system in Egypt. The scientific and technical implementation with the social and economic output of a 30 kW plant for irrigation in Wady EI-Natroon area was leaded by National Water Research Center (NWRC). In this manuscript the annual daily performance of the system's CPV modules is introduced. Also the response of the modules to rapid solar radiation variation is investigated. The definition of strategies for operation and energy management and its inclusion into the Energy Management System (EMS) while a submersible pump of an 18kw rated, connected directly to the system, at different speeds and variable loads is carried out. The CPV system was found to generate constant energy during sun rise hours without delay. The mechanical system is hindering and needs periodic maintenance. Cleaning of the module surface and back up batteries, in case of fogs and clouds, are required to give the maximum designed energy and to preserve system movement to follow the sun.
